Freemap GPS Recorder records your location — including while the app is closed or not in use — for as long as a recording is running, and for no other reason.\n\nFixes are written to this device only, into the app\'s private storage. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
Android will not offer this in a prompt, so it has to be set by hand.\n\nOn the next screen open Permissions → Location and choose \"Allow all the time\".

Android puts apps to sleep to save power. A sleeping recorder records nothing, and it is not told to stop — the track simply ends where the phone decided it should, usually with no warning at all.\n\nAllowing unrestricted battery use is what keeps a long recording intact. It is also what lets freemap.sk start a recording while you are looking at the website, so recording cannot begin without it.

This app is not on Google Play — it is downloaded from freemap.sk and installed by hand.\n\nThe first time you do that, Android will not install the file straight away: it asks whether the browser that downloaded it is allowed to install apps. Follow the prompt to Settings, turn the permission on for your browser, and go back — the install then continues. You only do this once per browser.

The app checks once a day, on Wi-Fi where possible and never during a recording, and offers a download when there is a newer version. Nothing is installed on its own.\n\nAn update installs over the top of this one and keeps your recorded track. Do not uninstall first — uninstalling takes the recording with it.
Obtainium can watch for new versions and install them for you. Add the app there by URL, using this address, and choose the \"APK Link\" or third-party source type:

The one that matters: lock the app in Recents, so clearing recent apps does not take the recording with it. On most MIUI and HyperOS versions you drag its card down in the task switcher.

Battery saver, on the app's own page in Settings, is the battery item above under another name — setting either one sets the other, so it is already done.

Autostart, on that same page, is not what keeps a running recording alive; it only decides whether the ROM may start the app again after killing it. Worth switching on, but it is not the fix.
Open Phone Manager → App launch, switch Freemap GPS Recorder from Manage automatically to Manage manually, and turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
Open Settings → Battery → Background usage limits, turn off Put unused apps to sleep, and make sure Freemap GPS Recorder is in neither the Sleeping nor the Deep sleeping list.
Open Settings → Battery → App battery management and allow Freemap GPS Recorder to run in the background.\n\nThen, in the phone manager\'s Startup manager, allow it to auto-start.
Open iManager → App manager → Autostart manager and enable Freemap GPS Recorder.\n\nThen, under Battery → High background power consumption, allow it as well.

Open Settings → Battery → Battery optimisation and set Freemap GPS Recorder to Don\'t optimise.\n\nIf your version has Advanced optimisation, turn off Deep optimisation and Sleep standby optimisation.
